title: Authorize generated Nous syncs through exact provenance

outcomes.statement: The readiness gate accepts an authentic, byte-bound Nous-generated sync without a hand-maintained overlay while continuing to reject generated-path hand edits and forged provenance.
outcomes.demo: Run three isolated Git fixtures: a complete sync-shaped candidate passes by provenance, the same generated path edited after sync fails with WR_GENERATED_NOUS_PATH, and a candidate whose provenance or manifest does not bind its project, substrate revision, source cleanliness, and exact generated bytes also fails closed.

uncertainties.statement: Whether the delivered metadata can bind a generated-file transition without consulting an unavailable Nous checkout during later CI validation.
uncertainties.resolution: Use only the candidate Git tree: require an atomic, closed-shape .nous-provenance.json, .nous-project.json, and .nous-sync.json envelope; require one project_id across all three; bind .nous-project.json substrate_commit to the prefix of the 12-hex provenance git_sha; and require every changed generated path to have a canonical manifest key whose 16-hex hash equals the first 16 hex characters of SHA-256 over that candidate blob. Missing, deleted, symlinked, malformed, extra-field, stale-hash, or partially supplied envelopes fail closed. The registered exact-overlay path remains as the historical fallback.

uncertainties.statement: Whether an unrelated dirty substrate file should invalidate an otherwise reproducible generated sync.
uncertainties.resolution: Do not treat dirty as an unconditional boolean veto. Normalize each changed generated entry's manifest source to its Nous-relative source path and reject when a listed dirty path is that source, contains it, or cannot be compared safely; unrelated dirty paths remain explicit provenance but do not authorize or invalidate unaffected generated blobs. The current Nous/System/IMP_SESSION_PLAYBOOK.md dirty path is disjoint from the CHG-045 generated sources under Nous/Specs, so this rule is both fail-closed for affected inputs and compatible with the supplied sync.

uncertainties.statement: Whether provenance authorization could accidentally exempt ordinary implementation paths from readiness ownership.
uncertainties.resolution: Limit the exemption to the already classified generated Nous paths plus the exact three-file sync envelope. A provenance-owned candidate containing any other implementation-class path continues through normal work-ID readiness and plan validation. A hand edit lacks a changed, byte-binding envelope and therefore still raises WR_GENERATED_NOUS_PATH.
